findings.summary: afldb_owner (database and table owner, DDL/TRUNCATE capable) is the narrowest existing role able to do the repair per discovery; breadth is inherent, mitigated by the pinned two-write SQL, and is the one owner-judgement item.
Immutable audit literal names model id claude-opus-5-5, which cannot be verified against the launching session; confirm before execution (a change requires re-review).

Write session re-runs host gate and credential checks after the marker, so a pre-database stop there consumes the attempt (conservative; matches after-marker semantics but narrower than the owner's wish).

Host-gate PASS path, stdin restoration into psql, ssh.exe argv script transport, login-shell behaviour and localhost resolution are unexercised off-production; any mismatch fails closed before the marker.

Validation claims slightly overstated: harness leak scan covers 3 of 8 evidence files (independent scan found no leak); wrapper VM uses an unpinned external fixture and synthetic psql output; validators write into manifested members and must not be re-run in place; PGlite omits principal.sql by design.
Password lives in PGPASSWORD in psql environment (not argv/listing); readable by arm and root via /proc environ (mode 400) and ps e by arm; same mechanism as the accepted observation.

Stale or unverifiable records: SEMANTICS.md says repair-body.sql byte-equal to v3; ACTOR-EVIDENCE.json:12 names Codex; v5 ruling excerpt is abridged, not verifiably verbatim; docs/deployment.md:1422 says PROD DSN unset though install script writes it.

Residual after F-006 closure: grep exit status 2 treated as no-match (lines 75,77,80); in-DB visibility check tests only own update_process_title; text-based DDL checks are blind to other roles and rely on process-title scan, pg_locks and prepared-xact checks.

scope: Exact-byte, read-only independent review of metadata-repair-v5 (43-member manifest) against frozen v4 (829fc30a...): v4-to-v5 member delta, two-write SQL and protected-data contract, afldb_owner principal selection and binding, credential safety, attempt semantics, operational host gate, validation adequacy. F-006 disposition: closed in v5. No package script, SSH, network, database, git or npm was run.
